notes: Tiers are cumulative: lead capture includes Presence, and the AI assistant includes lead capture. US visitors see us prices in USD. Argentina visitors see ar prices converted to ARS. Each Argentina dollar amount is one third of the matching US amount, rounded to the nearest dollar. setup is the launch price. regularSetup is the price after the launch offer ends. Monthly fees do not have a separate regular price. The launch block controls the banner, the strikethrough, and whether a tier sells at setup or regularSetup. spotsLeft is a manual count: nothing on the site decreases it or resets a timer.
